description: PAID tool ($0.25 USDC via x402, Base). Fact-check a claim against live web sources: the claim is decomposed into sub-claims, sources are fetched live, Jev jurors judge per-source-family entailment with verbatim-quote evidence that must pass an anti-hallucination substring gate, and the verdict is coherence-gated (coherence = |sum(w*d)| / sum(w) over source families, weights 3/2/1 by source class) and sealed as a stored receipt. Send the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header on the /mcp request; without payment the call returns the canonical x402 challenge (HTTP 402, amount 250000 = $0.25 USDC, payTo of the canonical SML receiver). If the jury is not configured the call fails before any payment is requested, so nobody pays for a check that cannot run.

claim.description: The claim to fact-check, as a single statement or a short paragraph.

sources.description: Optional public HTTPS source URLs to check against (max 8). When omitted or fewer than 2 are usable, ClaimGate searches the live web.

sub_claims.description: Optional caller-provided decomposition of the claim into sub-claims (max 4). When omitted, the claim text is split into sentences.
